capability_gate_precedes_retrieval.what: read-only strong_route_capability() mirror (zero network, zero probes; declared capabilities are probe-independent so the gate can never deadlock a route behind its own probe TTL — Art. V). When no reachable rung declares STRONG and a degraded rung exists, the conductor records BLOCKED/CAPABILITY_INSUFFICIENT before the RETRIEVE fan-out: zero retrieval source calls, zero downstream compute, resumable on a capable route (Art. LXI). New typed terminal RUN_BLOCKED_CAPABILITY (a RUN_BLOCKED_* family member — run_state outcome mapping, product events, run contract, investigation, worker phase 4, presentationState isTerminal/INFRASTRUCTURE_PAUSED all treat it as infrastructure class). The expensive tail and the evolution layer refuse with the same typed record; CAPABILITY_GATE.json joins the durable push.
capability_gate_precedes_retrieval.no_new_backend_machinery_note: the gate is a read-only mirror of generate()'s own admission inputs (catalog, pinned capability declarations, cost policy, known-dead marks) — no new capability store, no new probe, no second routing authority (Art. X)

no_skip_envelopes.what: SKIPPED_ADMISSION stages write their ledger line only; the per-stage envelope duplication of the unchanged problem block (9 per degraded run, candidate_id empty) is removed. The refusal remains a recorded refusal (Art. XXV).

model_route_from_ledger.what: model_route.calls derive from ROUTING_LEDGER_RUN.json (the run-id-isolated routing ledger persisted into the run dir at run end, R451-C1.3-3) with a ledger_for_run(run_id) fallback for legacy records; call_count is the ledger's run-owned count; envelope aggregation is dead. R443's retrieval-source exclusion is now structural (the ledger cannot contain a retrieval source).
